lines.en: I walk with quick, small steps.

lines.zh: 黄色的塑料脚踩得地板响。
lines.en: My yellow plastic feet click on the floor.
I carry my tray and pace about.
My skirt's edge brushes the game cabinet.

lines.zh: 我绕到展位前沿，又退回去。
lines.en: I come to the display's edge and back away.

lines.zh: 白天的我，只在小范围走。
lines.en: By day I keep to a small area.
I walk with my head slightly tilted.
I pause at the mouth of the corridor.
My decorative wings sway gently.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看有没有客人。
lines.en: I walk while watching for guests.
A few crumbs lie on the floor.
I slip past the arcade machine.
I stand holding an empty tray.
My beak is open in a smile.
By day I only want to draw guests in.
There's nothing on my tray.
I tilt my head and wait for someone.
The lamp is on my face.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤是塑料的，不冷。
lines.en: My skin is plastic; it isn't cold.

lines.zh: 我听见爆米花的机器在响。
lines.en: I hear the popcorn machine running.
There are no children in this crowd.
My eyes do a full turn.
Care for a serving, guest?

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我就笑着看你。
lines.en: You stare; I smile and stare back.
You don't have a tray.
Children like this face of mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的裙子上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my skirt.
I know you; you came last time.
That poster by the door has me on it.
I'm waiting to hear your order.
By day I don't take payment.
My tray clatters down.
A crack runs through the plastic.
I step back twice, smiling.
You've ruined my skirt.
I grip the counter and steady.
That crack was brittle.
You're rougher than I expected.
I cover the crack.
I'll remember this.
I don't eat that, guest.

lines.zh: 你手里那份，留着自己吃。
lines.en: Keep that serving for yourself.

lines.zh: 我端着托盘，但里面是空的。
lines.en: I carry a tray, but there's nothing on it.
Even raised high, it's out of reach.
No stomach here. No need to be polite.

lines.zh: 这点东西连个响都没有。
lines.en: That doesn't even make a sound.
Don't tease me with that.
Put it away, guest.
I'd rather hear you order.
Your hand's shaking. Shame to spill it.
You bump me and my tray wobbles.

lines.zh: 我是塑料的，撞起来很脆。
lines.en: I'm plastic; I knock brittle.
Step back; my skirt will wrinkle.
I'm light; I tip easily.
After the knock, my smile widens.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压住我的塑料脚趾。
lines.en: Your heel presses down on my plastic toes.
I sway twice and catch the counter.
Don't pull my wings.
By day I only stir on my stage.
Let me smooth my skirt.
Another one is on display in the shop.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，各自笑着。
lines.en: We stand side by side, each smiling.
Its tray is cleaner than mine.
We don't speak; we just smile at each other.
After lights out, it moves first.

lines.zh: 我们在后台碰了一下面。
lines.en: We meet in the back room.
It's a little taller than me.
We take two corridors.
Before dawn we must be back in place.
I bend and my tray tilts.
I pick up the crumbs on the floor.
I set this pearl on my tray.
I pinch it up gently.
When I crouch, my skirt spreads.
I'll keep this scrap of plastic.
Done, I settle my tray.
I tuck it into my apron pocket.
You knocked over my tray.
I was being courteous today.

lines.zh: 你看我这张脸，还笑得出来？
lines.en: Can you still smile at this face?

lines.zh: 灯灭之前，我有的是时间。
lines.en: Before the lights go out, I have time.
You've backed to the corridor mouth.
Shout if you like. No one will come.

lines.zh: 舞台灯下，我的喙对准你。
lines.en: Under the stage lights, my beak points at you.
My hands are cold. Try them.
Let's play a game.
When you hit me, I was smiling.

lines.zh: 这身衣服，跑起来不方便。
lines.en: This outfit isn't made for running.

lines.zh: 门口的帘子，我已经拉上了。
lines.en: I've drawn the curtain at the door.
Tray down first. Then you.
You hide behind the arcade machine.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在走廊里很响。
lines.en: Your steps echo loudly in the corridor.
I tilt my head and listen for you.

lines.zh: 你换了一条走廊，我也熟。
lines.en: You changed corridors. I know those too.
Your flashlight rolls on the floor.
Holding your breath now? Too late.
Under the table is too narrow.
I'm just outside the curtain.
Back again and you're at the rear wall.
I keep my eyes on your shoes.
Your shadow looms large on the wall.

lines.zh: 我数着你的每一次换气。
lines.en: I count each breath you take.
I've come around to the door on your side.
Don't run upstairs; it's darker up there.
I've set my tray by the door.

lines.zh: 你躲进储物间，门缝会说话。
lines.en: Hiding in the closet? The gap tells.
One more step and I'm there.
The tray comes at you, edge first.
The steel under the plastic is heavy.
That split your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你挡了一次，还有下一次。
lines.en: You blocked one. There's more.
I follow, still smiling.
You're shoved against the shelves.
I kick your shin.
That sound is satisfying.
I don't breathe, so I don't stop.

lines.zh: 你退后，我把裙子撩起来追。
lines.en: You retreat; I lift my skirt and follow.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你肩膀上了。
lines.en: My fingers are on your shoulder.
That left a mark.
Everything in your hands scatters.
I don't shout; it would bring guests.
The second is heavier than the first.
Your knees buckle.
I press your head down.
Enough. Keep still.
Someone placed me by the counter.
The shop opens and the lights come on.
I take up my tray and settle into pose.
More guests will come today.
I smooth my skirt.
The counter was just wiped.
The bell above the door chimed.
I raise my head from the display.
The shop radio is singing.

lines.zh: 线头露出来了，我塞回去。
lines.en: A loose thread shows; I tuck it in.
I smile and wait for the first guest.
The sun outside is still high.
The plastic warps in the heat.
I bounce once on landing.
Water seeps into my seams.
The blast knocks me over.
A round punches through my apron.

lines.zh: 光绕着我转，我动作一僵。
lines.en: Light circles me; my movement locks.
Out of power, my smile freezes.
Current runs across my shell.
I fall, and my tray falls with me.
